itemTexts.description: A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
Sturdy shafts that fly straight and true.
A stout stick covered in pitch.
Paper of superior quality needed for the etchings of magical words.
What they lack in taste they more than make up for in nutrition.
A strong coil make of Hemp and Flax.
A highly polished plate of pure silver.
Heavy Iron spikes capable of being driven into the hardest of stone.
In combination with flame this becomes a poor mans fireball.
A fine wine distilled in the sunken city of Waterford
A finer, sturdier blade.
The special alloys and magic dweomer of the blade make this sword an efficient weapon indeed.
A flexible container made of sturdy leather and rendered impermeable; very useful for holding water, especially when one finds oneself lost in an arid region.
The magical shield of the dwarven hero Galduur Ironshield. An item that will one day become legend.
Ever famous for its taste, its bouquet, its richness and its strenght, even this early in the history of the Sword Lands!
Rich, yet not too bitter or too sweet, it is still a far cry from the Wailsrond's rhum of your time!
Very nice body and bouquet; yet it is meek compared to the Tanirith's wine of your time!
This powerful weapon belonged to the First Captain of the Guards of Mountedge of old, before it became part of the Iron Kingdom.
Perfectly cut, these rubies are sought for their value and their beauty.
Crafted by a master bowyer and enchanted with dweomers to make it aim farther and better.
Rare indeed, these bows combine the best craftmanship and dweomercraft to make them deadly in the hands of any archer.
The weapon of choice of Keryndorhyan Psi-Knights, it can wound not only the flesh but the mind as well.
This fantastic bow was created ages ago by a ranger of Anarym, who's name remains a mystery in the Realmz.
Forged and crafted by fire giant masters, these armors not only protect against the cold but also provide a boon against the undead.
The miner's tool ... or a weapon for the desperate.
Forged and crafted by frost giant masters, these armors not only protect against fire but also provide a boon against denizens of Hell and the Abyss.
The first blade of this type was created centuries past by Nelecktran, the first electromancer.
Some say these helms were made ages ago to combat warriors with psionic powers.
It is said that he who wears this helm shall have the contentment of the simpleton.
A magnificent shield made of mithril, it is a boon for selfless paladins and crusaders.
The curse of a medusa shall be inflicted on he/she who wears this suit of armor.
A legendary item in the eyes of Mayaltecs, this shield belonged to the very first mayaltec Highking, Turoac.
A superb weapon with a powerful dweomer; unfortunately, it turns its owner into a coward.
An armor much sought after by psionicists and psi-warriors.
This magnificent blade has but one purpose only: to slay anything reptilian, including dragons.
These shields were used ages ago against warriors with psionic powers.
The symbol of mayaltec rulership passed down from one Highking to the next, ever since the ascension of the first Highking, Turoac.
The preferred blade of assassins and murderers for hire.
A fantastic dwarven battleaxe, usually given to dwarven heroes.
Light, yet sturdy and of high quality; made of mithril and special dwarven alloys: very well suited by and for its makers.
The regular weapon of dwarven warriors.
Magically reinforced boots, yet as comfortable as regular leather boots.
A shield for heroes ... dwarven ones, that is.
A blade made on the continent of Anarym, nothing is known of this wonderful sword.
A much sought after item by psionicists.
A robe much sought after by psionicists.
A terrible item used by slavers to break the will of their slaves.
Usually a gift offered by enemies to break one's will.
He/she who wears this shall be confused by the world around him/her.
A reinforced leather cap.
The processed pelt of a silverback wolf; great for clothing and warming. Also very valuable when sold.
An exquisite blade forged out of a mithril-adamandine alloy. Very sharp and deadly too.
The processed pelt of an animal; great for clothing and warming. Also valuable when sold.
This beautiful ring allows its wearer to fear no lightning.
Made of mithril and adamandine, this terrible weapon shreds both the flesh and the mind of its victims.
Well-balanced daggers that bear a strong dweomer to increase their accuracy.
A rod useful to help one get out fast of those dead-end situations.
This exquisite armor is forged with adamandine, the rare metal that's stronger than mithril.
Not much is known of this item which was created centuries ago on the continent of Anarym, except that its wielder is given powers to influence and rule others.
This superb armor was forged in endurinium, the rarest of metals that surpasses even mithril and adamandine.
A superb blade for the true warrior.
A battlestaff rumored to contain live electricity and lightning. Obviously designed for electromancers.
Made of a special mithril-steel alloy, this blade will cut true and through.
A magnificent shield made of mithril, it is a boon for devout servants of the Gods in their fight against the undead.
A terrible magic item which will turn its possessor into a frigid statue of the coldest of ice.
Seemingly comfortable, these boots have hidden needles which inject the deadliest of poisons, killing their wearer instantly.
This terrible weapon is known to render helpless any victim hit by its bloodthirsty blade.
A shield made of mithril-steel, it bestows many gifts to the warrior brave of heart against any enemy and monsters.
Legends say that this weapon was forged eons ago by Shanarack, God of Winter. This item will shrink or expand according to the size of its wielder, thus being usable by any warrior.
A better, sharper shortsword, bearing strong dweomers to enhance its efficiency.
For brawny mages, this wonderful weapon enhances its owner's attacks.
A very beneficial hat for any traveling minstrel.
A magnificent blade, this sword inflicts damage almost like a two-handed sword but is wielded like a broadsword.
Blessed by the Goddess of Life, Lharishar, for those deserving of her kindly boon.
These rare scrolls store the spell "destroy magic".
It is said that he/she who studies the writings of such a book shall gain greater knowledge.
A magical tome who's perusal causes an increase of vitality to the reader.
A magical tome for priestly castes whose secrets will enlighten its reader.
Truly a most prized boon for any true spellweaver.
Fear the touch of the God of Death and Murder ...
It is said that he (or she) who wears this terrible cloak shall never need fear death ...
What good can come out of a gift from the God of Disease, Decay and Corruption?
A failed ion stone. Although it provides some slight benefits, it renders one low of wits and intellect.
These terrible gloves are said to have been 'blessed' by Orcas, God of Undeath, Horrors and Terror.
These magnificent gloves once belonged to the monk Yuriko Moonjade, known for being able to electrocute her opponents with a touch.
A warhelm fabled among orcish tribes, it is said to bestow untold powers to those orcs that are true warriors by the standard of their peers.
Another example of splendid dwarven craftmanship, this crossbow is better than any other normal crossbow.
Another example of splendid elven craftmanship, this missile weapon easily outmatches any of its kind.
Rumored to have been blessed by Miellakkar, Goddess of the Forests, this quiver is a great boon to the archer/ranger caste.
A superb example of gnomish craftmanship, this is the epitome of leather-type armors.
Unrefined ore freshly mined.
Uncut and unrefined valuable stones freshly mined.
An uncut and unrefined valuable stone freshly mined.
An uncut and unrefined very valuable stone freshly mined.
A very rare item highly prized by alchemists and mages -its rarity comes more from the obvious, terrible dangers one must face to acquire one!
A superb armor of mithril-adamandine alloy, much lighter than its normal counterpart.
When donned, this marvelous cloak will confer camouflage powers, as well as other special attributes.
A magnificent unique bastard sword, it is said to protect its wielder as much as it helps him wound his opponents.
An old armor worn by the most prestigious descendants of the royal Nuramin Dynasty.
A magnificent stone, perfectly cut ... and perfectly valuable too.
A relic which will allow the True Gods to protect the faithful against the probings of the Mentarchs.
A key that will fit the lock of a very specific door.
A present-day lexicon about the Sword Lands of the year circa 529 R.R. Just click "Use" to peruse its contents.
A magical trans-temporal teleportation device which allows your swift return to the Towers of the Hourglass.
An artifact from the fabled empire of Telluria, the purpose of this strange object remains a puzzle.
Your typical leather pouch made to hang on a belt and to hold coins. Just click "Use" in order to partake of its contents!
A used map you found on one of the highwaymen that attempted to ambush you. Just click "Use" if you want to look it over.

monsterDescriptions.text: Long ago a wizard's experiment had gone afoul and this is the result.
Though they are not difficult to kill, take care.  Their bite is most poisonous.
Large, slow, stupid.  Put it all together, and you have a four- footed eating machine with sharp teeth.
A strange cross between an ogre and a bear.  These creatures were born of magic long ago.
These small dragons are by no means demure: it is therefore a good thing that they seek to fight evil, like their greater gold kin whom they attempt to emulate.
Not a true dragon.  Named after there ilk for it is the only beast known that can rival them in brute strength.
A mindless larva.  Nobody knows what this thing will turn into for no one has ever found one in a cocoon state.
Capable of launching a multitude of attacks, this critter is extremely deadly.
Strongest of the good dragons.  This race of dragon kind devotes their entire lives to the destruction of their evil kin.
A gaping maw of immense size makes this mindless foe one to  avoid.
Sickly in appearance, these foul creatures blend into their  surroundings and pounce on the unsuspecting.
A truly fearsome arachnid.  Avoid contact with this eight legged monstrosity, if at all possible.
Created from nonliving parts and given life through arcane magic.  They will serve their creator until destroyed.
A dinosaur and a super-predator to boost.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.  These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.   These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
A larger version of the ordinary troll.  The physical strength of these beasts is near god-like.
An old wretch with little to lose in life. Or so she seems ...
Often used to guard magical treasure or some important location.
A disgusting blind creature of the deep.  Four clawed feet, two tentacles and a trunk that resembles an elephant's; all combine to make this a creature to avoid.
A mountainous man-fish.
Though they look fierce, they are not as deadly as one might think.
Large and deadly.  Their saliva contains a strange chemical.  Those that do not save will become deathly afraid.
An odd sight, indeed.  Their appearance would be laughable, if they were not so deadly.  They favor the occasional orc to dine on.
A strange cross between a hyena and a tiger.  Nobody knows if it was spawned from magic or nature.
An intelligent reptilian race.  They are extremely evil and travel in large, highly organized groups.
Large, but stupid.  These reptiles have been known to trample an adult ogre without even slowing down.
Do not get too close!  If it gets you in a bear hug you are doomed for sure.
A giant boar with a bad attitude.
Formed from a colony of semi-intelligent mosses.
A real monster.
An apparition from beyond the grave.  Neither good nor evil by nature, it is still best to avoid such creatures.
Be careful not to fall victim to a bite from one of these.  Their bite has been known to cause paralysis.
A poisonous bite may be the least of your worries if you meet up with one of these vermin.
Sporting a nasty bite, these critters are more dangerous than they look.
Little is known about the greckle for they are secretive creatures that dabble in the black arts.
A powerful cousin to the modern day mountain lion.
Long ago, a tribe of trolls developed the ability to think.  Since then, they have developed a strong tribal society that rivals orcs and goblins.
Strongest of the evil dragons.  Few  have met with one AND LIVED!
Capable of breathing lightning.  Woe to the fools that find themselves in lonely company with one such as this.
One of the weaker races of dragon kind.  A sly mind and a taste for blood make green dragons a force to be feared.
A seasoned adventuress and dragon hunter to boot.
A strong goblin warrior that has risen above those of more ordinary skill.
The young of troll families.
An elven adventurer from the forest-kingdom of Lorill.
A common vermin of immense size.
A snake of unbelievable size.  Easily  60 feet in length and as large around as a full-grown bull vusk.
Large and heavily armored, with a bony back plate and horns.  Only a fool would back one of these things into a corner.
A ranger who looks strangely familiar to another one you have come to know, in another time. How could this be?
A hardy warrior trained for combat among the trees.
A true leader of men.  Trusted with  keeping the troops in line.
Created from non-living parts and given life through arcane magic.  They will serve their creator until destroyed.
In life, a valiant warrior. After his death, he was cursed with undeath to serve powerful beings.
Standing 8 feet tall or more, these large brutes love to bully those weaker than themselves.  They are often employed as troops in mercenary armies.
A strong family structure allows these giant reptiles to survive in a hostile environment.
Old crypts are the favorite haunt of these foul vermin.
Extremely strong for their size, these beasts would make excellent warriors if they were not so lazy.
Neither fast nor powerful, these nasty reptiles do have one advantage - a poisonous bite.
Hailing from some unknown plane, these beasts are often summoned by powerful enchanters to perform their bidding.
A blood-thirsty, monstrous version of your average bat. Its screech is strident enough to scare even the bravest of warriors.
The creature's favorite form of attack is to lower its armored head and charge.  Don't stand in front of it!
A semi-sentient animation of mosses, fungi and aquatic flora.
A little bigger than a green dragon, this sleek dragon prefers to live in humid, dark swamps or pools of hot, acid waters.
Also known as "Death Emerald". Born of pure evil.  Enough said?
Large and fierce, this race of half bear, half man is feared thoughout the land.
A powerful creature of the undead.  These creatures drain your life force.
An intelligent, but evil, lupine species. Its howl will make you run in fright.
Capable of regenerating, these creatures are almost indestructible.
They stand 16 feet at the shoulder. These swamp-dwelling gargantuan humanoids are selfish and do not care much for other races.
The bane of forests. They try to stun and entangle you with their powerful branches, or throw dart-like shards of wood at you.
Souls that have been damned to roam the astral plane.  If provoked, they can exist on the material plane for short periods.
A dwarven hero who's name is destined to become legend ...
Yellow mold.  Capable of inflicting a strong chemical and poisonous burn.
Olive Slime.   Capable of inflicting a strong chemical burn.
A larger variety of trolls, this one dwells in dark caves.
A creature of the undead.  Their strike can produce paralysis.
A storm of claws and fangs.  Your basic garden variety of giant spider.
An evil race of Ogre that has great malice for any surface dwelling race.
A humanoid raised from the dead to become one of the cursed undead.
Harpies are considered among the most evil minded of creatures.
Evil incarnate, these creatures feast on the terror and pain of those they choose as victims.
These dragons are a mix of red and black dragons.
Another type of animated construct often created by wizard to guard places or treasures.
Beware its spitting slime!
Beware its acid spit!
These huge mounds of evil sludge exude electrical power that stuns unwary victims so they can be digested.
These reptiles have very hard outer layer skin and a deadly poisonous bite.
A disgusting creature at best.  This  beast sports four clawed feet, two tentacles and a elephants trunk.  It's bite can also paralyze.
A monstruous version of your ordinary pond hopper.
The unleashed essence of a god-like Mentarch in all its terrible glory ... and fury!
The unleashed essence of the Hierarch of the Mentarchs (Mind Lords).
A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.
One of the best known humanoid races of the Realmz ... and one of the most reviled as well.
A monstrous version of the large reptilian super-predators.
The King of the Jungle.
A brave but somewhat unskilled troop.
A conscript with little to look forward to in the civilian world.  For this reason they often reenlist to become corporals.
Charged to keep the troops in line.
A true leader of men.
Skilled in the ways of combat and leadership.  An up and coming officer.
A skilled warrior of the dwarven nations.
A blaze of claw and fang.  The speed of these netherworld creatures is without comparison.
Normally, they feed on only the dead.  In times of hunger, they will often hunt their prey.
Abused as a youngster.  These ill- tempered men are common thugs for hire.
Pickpocket, cutpurse, burglar.  By any name, a thief is a thief.
A member of the warrior elite and nobility of the Iron Kingdom.
Leader of knights in the Iron Kingdom.
Killer snake of the jungles ...
A servant of the sun God Quetzalcoualt, this selfless crusader seeks to liberate his mayaltec tribe from the influences of the evil serpent priests.
Avoid the poisonous bite and the paralyzing sting of these large insects.
Half man.  Half fish.  All bad temper.
A lizard man tracker who has left his people, unable to live with their wickedness and savagery.
A small, but deadly variety of your every day troll.
A special type of mummy enhanced by powerful necromantic dweomers.
The common sewer- and sludge-dweller.
Leader of ogre raiding parties. A real rough and tough bully.
Capable of casting clerical spells. This humanoid should be feared.
Prefers to feed on the dead.  However, they will not hesitate to add a little fresh meat when it's available.
Belonging to the arachnid family, these large critters pack a paralyzing sting.
He is the toughest of his kin, so of course he leads gnath raiding parties.
A warrior of great skill and strength.
The priest of a tribe of orcs.
Strong and capable with arms.
A rogue half-elf as glib of tongue and wit as his great minstrel talents.
A cathoon ranger-adventurer.
Ratus Gigantus.
Skilled in the use of a bow.  These warriors prefer to pepper their enemies with fine yew wood shafts.
A paralyzing sting makes this large insect quite deadly.
Over two feet of mindless insect. Capable of overwhelming foes by their sheer numbers.
Large and fierce warriors of above average skill.
A goblin skilled in the use of a bow.
Shaman-King of the goblin tribe of the Bloody Bones.
The fur if this wolf is much sought after for its protective properties against cold.
The well known super-predator of woodlands.
The leader of the pack ...
Elven dogs are raised by their elven masters as mage wardogs. Packs are sometimes left behind in order to guard sacred elven places.
Trained to kill, this animal is another arsenal of attack for raiders and armies alike.
One of the rebels you've befriended; this sophisticated half-elf rogue has quite an artistic talent for acting and music.
A powerful witch in her own right, she has chosen to join you on your quest to restore the true timeline of Lhari-Orin.
A friend you made early on among your fellow slaves.
A friend you made early on among your fellow slaves, it is now revealed that she is capable of using magic.
An enigmatic enchantress who has chosen to join you on your quest to restore the true timeline of Lhari-Orin.
Foul creation of a mad mage.
Another one of your friends among the rebels, she is a good-natured elven enchantress, but who otherwise tends to keep much to herself.
An underground dweller that is more reptile than man.  They hate all surface dwellers.
A larger version of the worker ant. Bred to do battle and defend the nest.
The central brains behind an ant colony.  Her death is the death of the colony.
Resembling ghouls, these vile creatures often live among them.  They are much more powerful than ghouls.
Made of solid water; this creature's prefered attack is to splash its opponents with hot jets of water vapors to disorient and confuse them.
A creature made of pure fire.
A creature made of solid earth and rock. It's club-sized fists can knock you out easily.
A walking, raging storm of winds, snow and electricity.
A kobold, slave like you, that you befriended.
A roguish kobold with the heart of a warrior.
A kobold, slave like you, that you befriended.
A very slick person ...
A mysterious, secretive ranger you befriended during your earlier adventures in the Sword Lands.
A true creature of darkness ... beware its cold, paralyzing claws!
Thousands of tiny spots give this crab its name.  Though nowhere near as fast as a leopard, it is just as deadly.
The legendary dwarven hero; he crossed time with you to join you in the present.
Undisputed King of the orc tribe of the Stormriders.
The spectral spirit of the witch Librunae. She has accepted to accompany you in your quest to slay Black Kiss.
A priestess of Labelas Enoreth (Quanthaas); she received a dream which foretold of your arrival and commanded her to help you.
A tigtaur warrior-shaman who has chosen to help you against the Ssethanti, thus helping her tribe at the same time.
High Praetor and First Speaker of the Inner Council of Overlords.
Another vicious inhabitant of the Netherworlds.
Very tough and very hard to crack. They often have gems embedded in their rocky armored skin.
Second Speaker of the Inner Council of Overlords; older sister of Arla Qui.
Ninth Speaker of the Inner Council of Overlords.
Typical rogue, highwayman and bully.
The Highking of the Mayaltec tribe.
A proud warrior of the Mayaltec tribe of jungle barbarians. This tribe is rather civilized and organized, as opposed to other jungle barbarian tribes.
A proud warrior of the Mayaltec tribe of jungle barbarians. This tribe is rather civilized and organized, as opposed to other jungle barbarian tribes.
A tribesman of tropical jungles; the jungle barbarians are also known as 'savages'.
The cat people ...
The cat people ...
The ultimate abomination ... and she rules over all of the Ssethanti people.
Also known as 'abominations', these devout servants of Neralkuur have allowed themselves to be transformed into half-men, half-snakes.
Also known as 'abominations', these devout servants of Neralkuur have allowed themselves to be transformed into half-men, half-snakes.
He represents the epitome to all Ssethanti warriors.
Also known as the 'Snake People', the skin of these evil and vicious folk is like that of a snake's. They worship the dark God Neralkuur (Sseth).
A vicious creature of the night and or the Underearth. Beware its fearsome bite!
One of the higher demons of the Netherworlds.
Size, brute force and cunning make him the ideal Chief of a lizard man tribe.
Spiritual leader of lizard man tribes.
Not-so-mythical creatures of tropical jungles.  Beware their poisonous bite and their paralyzing sting ... It is said that their gaze can also charm their foes.
As the foul magic that sustains lichdom eventually fades, this is what remains of a lich while his soul is roaming the Astral Plane.  Beware its deadly wail!
Regular conscript in the times of the Iron Kingdom.
Regular conscript in the times of the Iron Kingdom.
Typical officer in the times of the Iron Kingdom.
Your typical 'I will do anything for loot' meddler and troublemaker ... sounds familiar?
A zealot seeking to convert all those he encounters ...
A sorcerer in his endless quest to acquire more power ...
A sorcereress in her endless quest to acquire more power ...
Your typical "I'll do anything for loot" troublemaker ... sounds familiar?
A lawless marauder adept at horse-riding.
A lawless marauder leader adept at horse-riding.
Very territorial, yet seldom seen, these giant-kin are said to have druidic powers. They live in any kind of dense woodlands.
These extremely rare wyrms roam the Astral Plane. Beware their spectral breath weapon!
An ancient black dragon a.k.a. 'Black Kiss' ... Her temper is as bad, and dangerous, as her breath weapon!
A huge green dragon ... her temper is as bad, and dangerous, as her breath weapon!
Offspring of a green dragon mating pair.
Half tiger, half humanoid.  This peaceful race relishes all that is good in life.
Your typical elf; skilled in swords, bow and a little magic to boot.
Your typical elf; skilled in swords, bow and a little magic to boot.
Leader of elven patrols.
An elf who has studied and mastered the arcane arts.
Spiritual leader of elven communities.
Swamp-dweller and terrifying monster; beware its many heads and acid spits!
A larger version than the usual slime, it has the ability to split up in numerous slimelings!
A psi-warrior of the Neo-Imperium of Lankharh; they are also known as 'overseers' to slaves throughout the Imperium.
A psi-knight of the Neo-Imperium of Lankharh; they are also known as 'overseers' to slaves throughout the Imperium.
A psi-knight commander of the Neo-Imperium of Lankharh; they are also known as 'overseers' to slaves throughout the Imperium.
Also known as the anti-paladin, the anti-thesis of the crusader.
Filthy claws and teeth make this creature a deadly menace.  Fear it's bite for it can paralyze.
A larger version of the common vermin.
Aslo known as barking demonlings. These small humanoids makes up for lack of strenght with quickness and cunning.
Aslo known as barking demonlings. These small humanoids makes up for lack of strenght with quickness and cunning.
Vassal of the Overlords; like all Keryndhoryans, he has psionic powers.
Vassal of the Overlords; like all Keryndhoryans, he has psionic powers.
Vassal of the Overlords; like all Keryndhoryans, he has psionic powers.
The old, one-eyed half-orc that has been encouraging the slaves to revolt.
These are ruthless but quite efficient bureaucrats of the Neo-Imperium of Lankharh, in charge of imperial affairs and state-own operations.
Bureaucratic assistants to Imperial Masters.
Also known as the 'Astral Brood', this race of evil, cunning beings is native of the Astral Plane. Beware their mental powers and their swiftness!
Leaders and commanders within the Ashaan'ru Brood. The best of them are also breeders for the Queen they serve.
Mother of an Ashaan'ru Brood; many such queens exist throughout the Astral Plane, each having absolute power over the Brood she has spawn.
Also known as an 'Astral Stalker', this loathesome entity is native of the Astral Plane ... It preys on anything it can find.
Another wandering, nightmarish creature of the Astral Plane. These predators often hunt in packs. Their tentacles paralyze and their gaze turns to stone.
The unleashed essence of a Mentarch ... in all its terrible glory!
Another predator of the underdark. It likes to lie camouflaged and in wait on the floor, or from a ceiling, then entrap its unsuspecting victim before devouring it.
A rebel sympathizer living in Ylsasnorh.
A powerful weaver of the Art.
A rogue versed in dastardly deeds of daring-do.
A wizard who specializes in the dark arts of necromancy. Often referred to as a Death Master.
A native of keryndhor, he is also a chronomancer of the mysterious Order of the Hourglass.
A leader of men on the battle field.
A typical sell-sword, she is as deadly as she is beautiful.
A wizard or priest specializing in electrical magic.
As fierce a warrior as his cousin, the dwarf.
A mad druid.
The chief advisor of Anthraxus Wildstorm.
The leader of the rebels in an alternate time line.
Spiritual leader of mayaltec tribes.
A drunken fool eager for a fight.
A drunken fool eager for a fight.
A wizard or priest specializing in electrical magic.
Also going by the name of brigand or highwayman, he is the scourge of civilized societies.
Also going by the name of brigand or highwayman, he is the scourge of civilized societies.
The owner of the Sleepless Dragon ... and quite the fighting monk to boot!
Elven guardian spirit. Fear her terrible wail.
Spiritual leader of cathoon communities.
An ambitious electromancer seeking to conquer the Iron Kingdom.
An ambitious Warlord seeking to conquer the Iron Kingdom.
An ambitious Warlord seeking to conquer the Iron Kingdom.
Just someone trying to earn a decent pay by protecting trade caravan convoys.
Just someone trying to earn a decent pay by leading trade caravan convoys.
Spiritual leader of dwarven communities.
Leader of Marauders.
Leader of bandits.
Leader of brigands.
Cursed with undeath to be used as a guardian of crypts. Its breath itself can spread disease.
The long-dead first king of Nur'Anaan, risen to destroy those that would rob his grave.
Created for one purpose only: to protect crypts. Its touch alone drains the very life out of living creatures.
Created for one purpose only: to protect crypts. Its touch alone drains the very life out of living creatures.
An undead wizard willingly serving his God or Goddess, even after death.
A powerful demon lord of fire who serves the Dark God Graaz'z.
A master at murder -for a hefty fee.
A murderer-for-hire.
The epitome of the orc warrior and a true general.
Living lightning.
Revived by Stygiax.
Revived by Stygiax.
A vassal of Lord Yon Maladore.
A fighter for hire.
A spiritual leader of gnomish communities.
An apparition from beyond the grave and extremely evil by nature.  It's good pactice to stay clear of these whispy creatures.
A power-hungry wizard.
An agent-spy of the Overlords.
Watch out the venomous pincers of this large bug!
A magically mutated crocodilian.
A fierce dragon-hunter and dragonslayer.
A warlock stygian troll.
A terrible, malignant creature from the nether plane of Shadows.
An amphibious version of your regular troll - and equally deadly.
A powerful lich of long ago.
An elite lizard man warrior.
A lonely warrior.
The true speakers of Quetzalcoualt.
Another wandering creature of the Astral Plane. Glyders group themselves in schools, feeding off plancton-like mites made of psionic energy.
End of list.
